# RK E&C Pte Ltd

> Singapore renovation and handyman contractor specialising in HDB flats and condos. One in-house crew for the whole job: renovation, handyman repairs, move-in / move-out cleaning, fixture fixing and Taobao furniture assembly. Singapore-registered (UEN 202442767D). Free site visit, fixed-price quotes, island-wide.

## About
- Company: RK E&C Pte Ltd (UEN 202442767D), Singapore
- Phone / WhatsApp: +65 8611 5854
- Email: hello@rkec.sg
- Service area: All of Singapore (HDB, condo, landed)
- Promise: free site visit, itemised fixed-price quote, in-house crew (not sub-contracted), clean handover

## Services
- [HDB Renovation Contractor](https://rkec.sg/renovation-contractor-singapore/): hacking with HDB permit, toilets, kitchens, waterproofing, tiling, plastering and painting, quoted line by line. Real 2026 jobs: Hougang two toilets + kitchen + ceilings $16,800; whole-flat replaster and repaint $6,550.
- [Aircon Servicing](https://rkec.sg/aircon-servicing-singapore/): own crew. General servicing $25-30 per unit, chemical wash $110 per unit, gas top-up $120, chemical overhaul quoted on site, new piping and condensate pumps.
- [Handyman](https://rkec.sg/handyman-singapore/): patching, drilling, mounting, silicone, door and hinge fixes, leaks and odd repairs. Fixed price per job, not hourly; flat-pack assembly from $50, cabinet installation $60-150 per cabinet.
- [Move-In / Move-Out / Post-Renovation Cleaning](https://rkec.sg/move-out-cleaning-singapore/): deep clean for handover, move-in or after renovation works, with paint touch-up, aircon servicing and make-good in the same visit
- [Fixture Fixing](https://rkec.sg/#services): lights, fans, taps, sinks, toilet bowls, curtain rails and TV brackets, supplied or yours, mounted and tested
- [Taobao Goods Assembly](https://rkec.sg/#services): flat-pack and imported furniture unpacked, assembled, levelled and wall-anchored
- [Painting & Tiling](https://rkec.sg/#services): full repaint, feature walls, floor and wall tiling, marble
- [Ceiling & Drywall](https://rkec.sg/#services): false ceilings, cove and L-box lighting, partition walls
- [Water Heater Installation](https://rkec.sg/water-heater-installation-singapore/): instant and storage heaters supplied, installed and replaced. Instant $250-600, storage $350-800+, wiring by a Licensed Electrical Worker.
- [Plumbing](https://rkec.sg/#services): taps, sinks, basins, toilet bowls, water heaters, concealed pipework, leak repair
- [Demolition & Hacking](https://rkec.sg/#services): hacking of walls, floors and fittings, full strip-out with debris cleared
- [Painting Services](https://rkec.sg/painting-services-singapore/): HDB and condo painting, whole-flat repaints from $450 (3-room), rooms from $120, ceilings, touch-up, anti-mould, sealer and plaster repair.
